I replied to Marcus in his DM to confirm that his standing call with the Tamsin Cold Chain team for the Driftwood rollout is now Tuesdays at 10:15. I said I'd keep it with his private notes and wouldn't change his calendar. He'd asked for no action, so I didn't add or move any calendar events and posted nothing anywhere else.

I didn't save a separate note to the knowledge brain. The brain automatically keeps direct messages, so his message is already stored there, and only Marcus can see it.
